# listEvents

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [listEvents](list-events.html)(key: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html)): [ListEventsResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-list-events-response/index.html)

Lists the events within a specific session.

#### Return

A [ListEventsResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-list-events-response/index.html) containing a list of events.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The composite identifier of the session whose events are to be listed. [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) must not be null.
